character_tex: Weyl-Kac characters at $z = 0$: $\chi_\lambda(q) = \eta(q)^{-\dim G}\sum_{\beta\in Q^\vee}\prod_{\alpha>0}\frac{(\alpha,\lambda+\rho+K\beta)}{(\alpha,\rho)}\,q^{|\lambda+\rho+K\beta|^2/2K}$, $K = k + h^\vee$, long roots of length$^2$ 2 (here $\dim G = 14$, $h^\vee = 4$, $K = 5$). One block per integrable highest weight, labelled by the $G_2$ irrep; $h_{\mathbf{1}} = 0$, $h_{\mathbf{7}} = \tfrac{2}{5}$.
description: Diagonal modular invariant of the $G_2$ WZW model at level 1, $c = k\dim G/(k+h^\vee) = \tfrac{14}{5}$. Characters from the Weyl-Kac formula specialised to $z=0$ (the finite Weyl sum becomes the Weyl dimension factor and the denominator becomes $\eta^{\dim G}$ by the Macdonald identity), summed exactly over the coroot lattice. The generator checks the Macdonald identity, the leading terms $\dim\lambda\, q^{h_\lambda-c/24}$ and that the weight-1 space of the vacuum module has dimension $\dim G = 14$, and compares with independent formulas: the conformal embedding $(G_2)_1\times(F_4)_1\subset(E_8)_1$: $\chi_{\mathbf{1}}\chi_{\mathbf{1}} + \chi_{\mathbf{7}}\chi_{\mathbf{26}} = \chi^{(E_8)_1}$.
